description: This file defines a PHP trait named OAuthServerTrait within the OrangeHRM project. The trait provides a method to retrieve an OAuthServer instance from the service container, and it uses another trait ServiceContainerTrait. It is part of the OAuth plugin's traits, indicating it supports OAuth server functionalities within the system.

methods.name: getOAuthServer
methods.description: Returns an instance of OAuthServer from the service container.
